summary: Join our international trade and global supply chain training course. Gain essential knowledge and skills to navigate the complexities of global commerce.
lede: International trade training helps teams coordinate cross-border shipments, customs information, and supplier activity. It is suited to import coordinators, export specialists, procurement officers, customs compliance analysts, and logistics managers who handle trade decisions and documentation. Participants practise product classification, customs valuation and origin analysis, apply Incoterms 2020, review trade documents, and use freight planning and supply chain KPIs to assess performance.
audienceIntro: This international trade training suits professionals who coordinate cross-border transactions, supplier networks, customs processes, freight movements, and executive supply chain reporting. It supports foundation to intermediate learners who work with trade documents or supply chain decisions and want a structured, internationally applicable operating approach.
modules: International Trade Foundations and Flow Design
Global Supply Chain Planning and Logistics
Trade Compliance Risk and Supplier Governance
Supply Chain Data, Automation, and KPIs
International Trade Strategy and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic exposure to purchasing, logistics, customs documentation, importing, exporting, or supply chain operations. No programming is required. You should bring a working example of a cross-border shipment or supplier flow if organizational policy permits; otherwise, TrainingCred can provide anonymized practice data. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted classification and global trade management systems (SAP GTS or equivalent) remain at operational awareness level, while HS classification, Incoterms 2020, landed-cost analysis, and documentation controls receive applied workshop treatment.
